what_happened: Decision record found that none of R1-R4 actually requires reversing 901's Recommendation 8 to make progress: R2 was already unblocked (927), R3 and R4's schema-level sub-questions were never barred (only paper-vs-Lean scoping was unclear), and R1 is blocked by a separate, second clause of Recommendation 8 (the CSLib require bar) rather than the engine-content clause. Separating the two clauses let the ruling be precise instead of a blanket reopen/keep-closed on an undifferentiated bar.

Premise re-validation at plan time caught a stale carried figure before it reached the plan's phases: the description's claim that 'the completeness front currently has zero tasks of any kind: no active record carries topic completeness' is now false -- 926, 927 and 928 all carry topic:completeness in live state.json, and tasks 931/932 (filed by 927 on route R2) sit on the front with no topic tag. The ruling's four dispositions are unaffected, since the front gained tasks only via R2, the never-barred route. Phase 1 of the plan carries this as an explicit correction task with a Scope Hypothesis telling the implementer to re-measure rather than adopt the plan-time count.

Phase 1 premise re-validation re-ran all carried-figure lookups from the plan's Scope Hypothesis; found exactly the one stale premise ('zero tasks') the hypothesis anticipated, with all six other carried claims (901 Rec 8 wording, two ROADMAP sentences, 927's three declarations/locations, 927's axiom profile, 928's costing/siting, 906 Rec 4 wording) confirming verbatim at their cited lines. No additional stale figure found.

Phase 3 declares Verification Tier: full, and this dispatch carries a Batch Gate Deferral directive. Neither narrowing invocation (run-all.sh --only SUITE, verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N) maps to this phase's actual touched files (specs/926/**.md only, no .claude/**, no shell suites, no Lean) -- verify-deploy.sh's gates all target deploy-tree-vs-source-store sync or shell test suites, none scoped to specs/**.md content. Treated as the dispatch's own UNMAPPABLE CRITERION carve-out: ran the phase's own named checks directly instead (validate-artifact.sh on report and summary, both PASS; git status --short scoped review confirming no .lean file and no out-of-scope path touched by this task's commits). The complete verify-deploy.sh gate set is deferred to the batch-level stage per the dispatch's own directive, not independently run here.
